governance_service_sole_policy_owner.details: GovernanceService is the single authoritative owner for CW01/CW03/CW04 availability, surface state, projection, and redaction policies. Default dataset surface status fails closed to "unavailable" when source is missing or unknown. dataset_source defaults to "missing" when callback is absent or returns None. Callback exceptions in _safe_dataset_surface_status fail closed to "unavailable".

unavailable_dominates_and_fail_closed_in.details: Explicit collection surface state helpers (committee_collection_surface_state and memo_collection_surface_state) enforce that an unavailable underlying dataset dominates and renders the collection "unavailable". In list_committees, an unavailable collection suppresses items (data: [], next_cursor: None, total_count: 0), matching list_consult_memos. consult_memo_projection strictly disables canInitiateGovernanceReview (False) whenever record or collection surface state is degraded or unavailable. Redaction failures fail closed to "redaction_policy_unavailable".

router_divergent_defaults_removed.details: Removed router-level pass-through redaction _default_redact_evidence_refs and optimistic _default_dataset_surface_status; router now delegates both to GovernanceService. Missing surface in _default_read_surface_meta defaults to source="missing". Router list_committees delegates surface state resolution directly to service.committee_collection_surface_state.

contract_test_matrix_and_red_cases.details: Extended prerequisite test suite to 29 tests (21 predecessor + 8 new), covering: 3 fixed red cases ((1) memo degraded x dataset unavailable suppresses summary & forces CTA False; (2) omitted provenance is not ok/fresh & CTA False; (3) router omitted redactor + capabilities=[] reveals no strategy evidence); the full 16-combination (4 record x 4 dataset states) availability and CTA truth table for both CW03 committees and CW04 memos across both service and router; callback exception fail-closed handling; positive authorized real-redactor disclosure; and read-only production composition wiring.
